title: wave-hologram: off-axis digital holography with measured focus
description: Off-axis digital holography: record a hologram, reconstruct the object by numerical back-propagation, and measure the focus distance. Includes synthetic examples, an offline focus game, and validation against logged stage positions on real microscope holograms.

creators.name: Brisson, Jean-François
creators.affiliation: Spark AI NLP, Fredericton, New Brunswick, Canada
